hubTrigger.claim: RMB reached a more-than-3.5-year high and PBOC resistance to appreciation eased.
Brent and WTI fell to roughly two-week lows, with Brent below $100 amid improved Middle East supply prospects.

candidates.name: 南方航空
evidence: At 2026H1, a 1% RMB appreciation versus USD would reduce net loss by about RMB237m, the largest sensitivity among the three state airline controls examined.
H1 attributable loss was RMB3.696bn, making cost relief potentially meaningful but insufficient by itself to prove a turnaround.
risk: oil remains elevated despite recent decline

candidates.name: 中国东航
evidence: A 1% RMB appreciation versus USD would reduce loss by about RMB153m; H1 already recorded RMB585m FX gains because RMB strengthened.

candidates.name: 中国国航
evidence: A 1% RMB appreciation versus USD would increase net profit/equity by roughly RMB151m equivalent at H1 balance-sheet exposures.

mappingConclusion: This is a fresh absolute cost-relief channel rather than a relative-only sector story, but operating losses and still-high fuel prices keep it from automatic promotion.
